findings: Without a volume envelope,keyOff sets realVol and outVol to zero. With zero fadeout,subsequent channel-volume or instrument-default restores can resume the active sample.
A note without an instrument does not reset channel volume. It must retain the zero after release unless a volume/default restore explicitly changes it.
Retrigger research exposed this separate release-state question. No E9x implementation is proposed here.
fixture_scope: Fourteen authored zero-envelope,zero-fadeout inputs versus independent volume-zero controls; nine failures,five healthy controls including natural sample end. No full FT2 bit-exact claim.
